---
title: "Revelation"
---

# Revelation

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Revelation unveils the ultimate triumph of God, the victory of Jesus Christ, the defeat of evil, and the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan. The book teaches that Christ reigns sovereignly over history, His people are called to faithful endurance, and God's kingdom will culminate in a new creation where He dwells forever with His redeemed people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 1:8</div>

<div class="identifier">I am Alpha and Omega</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational declaration of Christ's eternity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the revelation given to John and presents the glorified Christ. The key verse emphasizes Jesus' sovereign authority over history, death, and the church.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 2:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Be thou faithful unto death</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Revelation's most quoted exhortations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains messages to the churches of Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, and Thyatira. The key verse highlights Christ's call for faithfulness, repentance, and perseverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 3:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Behold, I stand at the door and knock</div>

### Why This Verse

Perhaps the most quoted verse in Revelation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains messages to Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea. The key verse emphasizes spiritual vigilance, endurance, and wholehearted devotion to Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 4:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou art worthy, O Lord</div>

### Why This Verse

Heavenly worship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter transports John to heaven's throne room. The key verse reveals God's absolute sovereignty and worthiness of worship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 5:5</div>

<div class="identifier">The Lion of the tribe of Judah</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous messianic title

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the Lamb who alone is worthy to open the scroll. The key verse celebrates Christ's redemptive work and authority over God's purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 6:10</div>

<div class="identifier">How long, O Lord?</div>

### Why This Verse

Cry of the martyrs

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the opening of the first six seals. The key verse demonstrates God's control over judgment, history, and human events.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 7:17</div>

<div class="identifier">God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes</div>

### Why This Verse

Comfort and restoration

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reveals God's protection of His people and a vast multitude worshiping before His throne. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness to preserve and redeem His people from every nation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 8:1</div>

<div class="identifier">There was silence in heaven</div>

### Why This Verse

Dramatic prophetic moment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter opens the seventh seal and introduces the first four trumpet judgments. The key verse emphasizes that God's judgments proceed according to His sovereign plan and in response to the prayers of His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 9:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Men shall seek death, and shall not find it</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment imagery

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the fifth and sixth trumpet judgments. The key verse highlights both the severity of judgment and humanity's continued refusal to repent.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 10:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou must prophesy again</div>

### Why This Verse

Continuing witness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the mighty angel and the little scroll. The key verse emphasizes God's certainty in fulfilling His purposes and the prophet's responsibility to proclaim His message.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 11:15</div>

<div class="identifier">The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord</div>

### Why This Verse

Major kingdom proclamation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the ministry of the two witnesses and the sounding of the seventh trumpet. The key verse celebrates God's coming reign over all the kingdoms of the world.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 12:11</div>

<div class="identifier">They overcame him by the blood of the Lamb</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted victory verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter portrays the woman, the child, and the dragon. The key verse reveals the ongoing spiritual conflict between God's purposes and Satan's opposition.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 13:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast</div>

### Why This Verse

Most famous apocalyptic verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the beast from the sea and the beast from the earth. The key verse warns of deceptive worldly powers that oppose God and seek worship for themselves.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 14:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently used funeral text

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the victorious Lamb, the faithful redeemed, and announcements of coming judgment. The key verse emphasizes perseverance and faithfulness among God's people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 15:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Great and marvelous are Thy works</div>

### Why This Verse

Song of Moses and the Lamb

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the final bowl judgments and celebrates God's holiness and justice. The key verse emphasizes that God's judgments are righteous and worthy of worship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 16:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed is he that watches</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to readiness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the pouring out of the seven bowl judgments. The key verse demonstrates the completion of God's wrath against persistent rebellion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 17:14</div>

<div class="identifier">The Lamb shall overcome them</div>

### Why This Verse

Victory of Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the judgment of Babylon the Great. The key verse reveals the downfall of a corrupt world system opposed to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 18:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Come out of her, My people</div>

### Why This Verse

Separation from Babylon

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues Babylon's fall and calls God's people to separate from her sins. The key verse emphasizes the certainty of God's judgment upon worldly pride and corruption.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 19:16</div>

<div class="identifier">King of Kings and Lord of Lords</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Christ's greatest titles

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates heaven's praise, the marriage supper of the Lamb, and Christ's victorious return. The key verse presents Jesus as King of kings and Lord of lords.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 20:12</div>

<div class="identifier">The books were opened</div>

### Why This Verse

Final judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Satan's final defeat, the Millennium, and the Great White Throne Judgment. The key verse highlights God's final victory over evil and the ultimate accountability of humanity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 21:4</div>

<div class="identifier">God shall wipe away all tears</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most beloved promises in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reveals the New Heaven, New Earth, and New Jerusalem. The key verse promises God's eternal presence with His people and the removal of all suffering.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Revelation 22:13</div>

<div class="identifier">I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end</div>

### Why This Verse

Final declaration of Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes with the river of life, final exhortations, and Christ's promise to return. The key verse expresses the believer's longing for Christ's coming and eternal fellowship with Him.
:::
